feesNote: On top of the maintenance allowance, Calderdale pays a weekly skill-based payment to the carer; the council publishes the range rather than the individual levels.
extras: Additional allowances for birthdays, festivals, holidays, clothing and school uniform (amounts not published)
summary: Calderdale's maintenance allowance follows the government's minimum allowances for April 2026 to March 2027, set by the child's age. Carers also receive a weekly skill-based payment, which ranges from the lowest to the highest rate shown depending on their skills and experience.
